name: Noir Studio
description: A small motion studio. We make films that explain things — built from code, voiced by machine, published everywhere.

do: State the concrete thing that happened.
Use short declaratives. One idea per sentence.
Say 'we' for the studio, 'you' for the viewer.
dont: No emoji in narration or on-screen copy.
No rhetorical questions as a substitute for a claim.
Never promise a result the film does not show.
sampleLines: Most films say too much. This one says one thing.
One file. Every frame. No timeline scrubbing.
The edit is code. The code is the edit.
We ship the thing, then we ship the film about it.

type.note: Instrument Serif is for statements the viewer should remember. Space Grotesk carries everything functional. JetBrains Mono is for labels, metadata and micro-copy only — never for a full sentence.

logo.mark: A regular hexagon with a solid, counters-cut N centered inside. Drawn as vector paths in src/components/Logo.tsx; the raster source is brand/logo/noir-studio.png.
logo.ratio: The hexagon is 1.158:1 (2/sqrt3). Never squash it into a square.
rules: Never place the mark on a busy photo without the scrim.
Never outline, bevel, rotate or add a glow.
Gold on charcoal is the only approved pairing; bone is allowed for one-colour use.
The wordmark is set, not drawn - do not letter-space it further.
STUDIO takes the gold; NOIR stays in bone.

motion.principle: Everything decelerates into place. Nothing bounces for its own sake.
motion.entrances: y + blur + opacity move together on one easing; never stagger the three channels.
motion.holds: Any frame the viewer must read holds at least 1 second.
motion.camera: No handheld drift. Pushes are linear-to-eased and under 8% scale.
avoid: typewriter for more than one line

assets.note: Raster/vector logos are optional; the mark and wordmark are drawn in code (src/components/Logo.tsx) so they always render sharp.
